// why: This directory is imported by both the desktop app and the mobile app.
Without a tsconfig of its own, esbuild resolves one for these files by
walking up to v2/tsconfig.json, which extends ./.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json
— a file SvelteKit generates. The mobile build never runs svelte-kit sync,
so in a clean checkout it died with 'failed to resolve extends'. Stopping
resolution here keeps the two apps independent of each other's tooling.
Settings match the intersection of both apps' configs.
